profiles.name: DTCBull_Finance
profiles.bio: Long NKE since 2018. DTC transition is the real story here.

profiles.name: ValueInvestor_CFA
profiles.bio: CFA. Nike's moat is real but the multiple is stretched. Cautious.
profiles.persona_text: Rigorously analytical. Posts DCF models. Skeptical of celebrity endorsements as ROI drivers. Respects Nike fundamentals but worried about China exposure.

profiles.name: ShortsOnNKE
profiles.bio: Nike is a marketing company pretending to be a sportswear company. Overvalued.
profiles.persona_text: Bearish on Nike. Points to margin compression, wholesale channel cuts, and rising competition. Dismissive of hype-driven analysis.
